subject: Social Media
title: Digital Voter Suppression
description: A 60-second lesson on Digital Voter Suppression.

hook.text: Ads targeted at Black voters told them to 'skip the election' or 'text your vote.' Both were lies designed to suppress.

buildup.text: Digital voter suppression uses targeted ads to discourage specific groups from voting. It's cheaper than persuasion.

discovery.text: In 2016, the IRA specifically targeted African Americans with 'don't vote' messages on Facebook and Instagram.

twist.text: Suppression is harder to detect than persuasion. You can't prove someone didn't vote because of an ad they saw.

climax.text: The old way blocked access to polls. The new way makes people choose not to go. Same result, digital method.

punchline.text: The cheapest way to win is to stop others voting.

quiz.question: How does digital voter suppression primarily work?
options: Targeted ads discouraging specific groups from voting
